item.text: {"answers":[{"query_id":"cb-01","answer":"`(*Command).ExecuteC` initializes a background context if needed, redirects execution from a child to its root, invokes the Windows pre-execution hook, initializes default help/completion commands, checks command groups, and uses configured args or `os.Args[1:]` by default (`command.go:1051-1082`). It returns the selected `*Command` and an error; `Execute` discards the command and returns only the error (`command.go:1035-1041`)."},{"query_id":"cb-02","answer":"`(*Command).MarkFlagsMutuallyExclusive(flagNames...)` merges persistent flags, verifies every named flag exists (panicking otherwise), and annotates each with the space-joined group under `cobra_annotation_mutually_exclusive`. Repeated calls append groups, so a flag may belong to multiple groups (`flag_groups.go:25-29,63-78`)."},{"query_id":"cb-03","answer":"`doc.GenMarkdownTree(cmd, dir)` generates Markdown pages for a command and all descendants. It calls `GenMarkdownTreeCustom` with an empty file prepender and identity link handler (`doc/md_docs.go:119-130`); the custom function recursively processes available non-help-topic children, then writes the current command to `<CommandPath_with_underscores>.md` (`doc/md_docs.go:131-158`)."},{"query_id":"cb-04","answer":"`(*Command).RegisterFlagCompletionFunc` registers a Go completion callback for a named flag. It returns an error if the flag does not exist or already has a callback, and protects the global flag-to-function map with `flagCompletionMutex` (`completions.go:35-36,132-148`)."},{"query_id":"cb-07","answer":"`flag_groups.go` implements Cobra flag-group annotations and validation. It defines annotation keys for required-together, one-required, and mutually-exclusive groups (`flag_groups.go:25-29`), includes helpers such as `hasAllFlags` (`flag_groups.go:111-119`), and reports partially set required groups with their missing flags (`flag_groups.go:144-165`)."},{"query_id":"cb-08","answer":"`doc/man_docs.go` generates man pages. `GenMan` initializes a nil header, fills its defaults, renders the command through `md2man`, and writes it (`doc/man_docs.go:103-116`). `fillHeader` defaults the title, section, date—honoring `SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH`—and autogenerated source text (`doc/man_docs.go:118-141`); tree generation is configured through `GenManTreeOptions` (`doc/man_docs.go:82-88`)."},{"query_id":"cb-09","answer":"`shell_completions.go` provides flag annotations used by shell completion. For example, `MarkFlagRequired` sets `BashCompOneRequiredFlag` to `\"true\"` (`shell_completions.go:35-40`), while `MarkFlagFilename` and `MarkPersistentFlagFilename` restrict completion to specified file extensions on local and persistent flag sets respectively (`shell_completions.go:42-46,58-63`)."},{"query_id":"cb-11","answer":"Required flags are checked by `(*Command).ValidateRequiredFlags` in `command.go:1146-1169`. Unless flag parsing is disabled, it visits all applicable flags, finds those annotated with `BashCompOneRequiredFlag == \"true\"`, collects unchanged flags, and returns `required flag(s) ... not set` when any are missing."},{"query_id":"cb-12","answer":"`(*Command).Find` recursively searches downward from the highest command (`command.go:724-748`). At each level it strips flags, takes the first remaining argument, resolves it with `findNext`, removes that command token, and recurses; if no subcommand matches, it returns the current command and remaining args. It then applies `legacyArgs` only when the selected command has no custom `Args` validator."},{"query_id":"cb-13","answer":"`SuggestionsFor` examines each available child command and suggests its name when the case-insensitive Levenshtein distance is within `SuggestionsMinimumDistance`, when its name has the typed text as a case-insensitive prefix, or when the text case-insensitively matches an entry in `SuggestFor` (`command.go:831-851`). `findSuggestions` disables this entirely when `DisableSuggestions` is set and otherwise defaults a nonpositive distance threshold to 2 (`command.go:750-766`)."},{"query_id":"cb-14","answer":"Shell scripts invoke the hidden `__complete` command, or `__completeNoDesc` when descriptions are unwanted (`completions.go:26-33`; `powershell_completions.go:34-37`). The hidden command's `Run` callback dispatches the supplied command line to `cmd.getCompletions(args)`, receives the final command, candidates, directive, and error, and continues far enough to emit the directive even on error (`completions.go:202-213`)."},{"query_id":"cb-15","answer":"During execution, `InitDefaultVersionFlag` does nothing if `Command.Version` is empty or a `version` flag already exists. Otherwise it adds Boolean `--version`, gives it `-v` if that shorthand is free, and annotates it with `FlagSetByCobraAnnotation` (`command.go:1200-1225`). Completion logic recognizes a changed Cobra-created version flag through that annotation (`completions.go:522-533`)."},{"query_id":"cb-16","answer":"Levenshtein distance is computed by `ld(s, t, ignoreCase)` in `cobra.go:187-222`, using a dynamic-programming matrix and optional lowercasing. Command suggestions call it as `ld(typedName, cmd.Name(), true)` (`command.go:836-837`)."},{"query_id":"cb-19","answer":"INSUFFICIENT The response shows `Execute` calling `ExecuteC`, `ExecuteC` calling `cmd.execute`, and part of `execute` around initialization and argument validation, but omits the actual Run-hook invocation sequence needed for the complete lifecycle (`command.go:926-944,1038-1039,1114-1124`)."},{"query_id":"cb-20","answer":"Persistent flags are stored in each command's `PersistentFlags` set (`command.go:1725-1735`). For a child, `mergePersistentFlags` calls `updateParentsPflags`, then adds both its own persistent set and the accumulated parent persistent set to `Flags()` (`command.go:1847-1855`). A named lookup similarly falls back through `persistentFlag`, which updates and searches `parentsPflags` (`command.go:1805-1816`)."},{"query_id":"cb-21","answer":"`parent.AddCommand(children...)` rejects adding the parent to itself, assigns `child.parent = parent`, updates the parent's maximum display lengths, propagates any global normalization function, appends each child to `parent.commands`, and marks the collection unsorted (`command.go:1302-1330`). `Parent()` simply returns that stored pointer (`command.go:1842-1845`)."},{"query_id":"cb-22","answer":"The man-page generator walks the tree depth-first and post-order. `GenManTreeFromOpts` iterates `cmd.Commands()`, skips unavailable commands and additional help topics, recursively generates each remaining child, then creates and writes the current command's man page (`doc/man_docs.go:46-80`)."},{"query_id":"cb-24","answer":"`enforceFlagGroupsForCompletion` first returns when flag parsing is disabled (`flag_groups.go:225-228`). Group processing reads each flag's annotations, ignores a group unless all its flags exist, initializes member states, and records each member's `Changed` status (`flag_groups.go:121-142`). Its documented mutually-exclusive behavior is to hide the other group members when one is present, allowing normal completion filtering to enforce the group (`flag_groups.go:220-224,273`)."},{"query_id":"cb-25","answer":"Set `rootCmd.CompletionOptions.DisableDefaultCmd = true`. `CompletionOptions.DisableDefaultCmd` is explicitly documented as preventing creation of the default `completion` command (`completions.go:103-117`), and `InitDefaultCompletionCmd` returns immediately when it is true (`completions.go:683-686`)."},{"query_id":"cb-26","answer":"Active Help is controlled per program by `<PROGRAM>_ACTIVE_HELP`, where the root command name is uppercased and non-ASCII-alphanumeric characters are replaced with underscores (`active_help.go:45-67`). The global `COBRA_ACTIVE_HELP=0` overrides it and always disables Active Help (`active_help.go:45-58`)."},{"query_id":"cb-27","answer":"Set the package-level variable `cobra.EnablePrefixMatching = true`; its declaration says this enables automatic prefix matching (`cobra.go:51-56`). Command matching then accepts `hasNameOrAliasPrefix(next)` when the setting is enabled (`command.go:774-775`)."},{"query_id":"cb-28","answer":"A command's `GroupID` selects the group under which that subcommand appears in its parent's help output (`command.go:73-75`). Groups themselves have an `ID` and `Title` (`command.go:41-46`) and are registered with `AddGroup` (`command.go:1356-1359`); help and completion commands have setters for assigning their group IDs (`command.go:332-345`)."},{"query_id":"cb-30","answer":"Call `doc.GenManTree(cmd, header, dir)`. It generates a man page for the command and every descendant and accepts a nil header; internally it calls `GenManTreeFromOpts` with the destination path and `\"-\"` command separator (`doc/man_docs.go:33-45`). Names containing `-` can produce ambiguous filenames, as documented in the same span."},{"query_id":"cb-32","answer":"`(*Command).Execute()` uses `os.Args[1:]` by default, walks the command tree to match commands and flags, calls `ExecuteC`, and returns only its error (`command.go:1035-1042`). To supply a context, `ExecuteContext` assigns `c.ctx` before calling `Execute` (`command.go:1027-1034`)."},{"query_id":"cb-33","answer":"`(*Command).Flags()` returns the complete applicable `FlagSet`, covering flags declared locally plus persistent flags declared on the command and its parents (`command.go:1641-1653`). It lazily creates the set with `ContinueOnError` and directs flag errors to the command's buffer. `LocalNonPersistentFlags` filters that set to flags that do not persist to children (`command.go:1655-1666`)."},{"query_id":"cb-35","answer":"`InitDefaultCompletionCmd` adds a `completion` command that generates shell autocompletion scripts (`completions.go:678-715`). It does nothing when explicitly disabled, when the command has no subcommands, or when a command or alias named `completion` already exists. The generated command is no-args, disables file completion, and respects hidden/no-description options."},{"query_id":"ci-1133","answer":"Inside the executing command's callback, call `cmd.Flag(\"name\")`. `(*Command).Flag` first looks in the command's applicable `Flags()` and then searches its own and ancestor persistent flags through `persistentFlag` (`command.go:1794-1816`)."},{"query_id":"ci-1222","answer":"For a flag, call `cmd.RegisterFlagCompletionFunc(\"flag-name\", func(cmd *Command, args []string, toComplete string) ([]string, ShellCompDirective) { ... })` and return candidate strings plus a completion directive. The required callback signature is shown in `completions.go:133-134`; registrations are stored per `*pflag.Flag` (`completions.go:36`)."},{"query_id":"ci-1236","answer":"Call `cmd.CalledAs()` on the selected command. It returns the exact command name or alias used to invoke it, or an empty string if it has not been called (`command.go:1515-1523`). Prefix matching also records whether the matching name or alias was used (`command.go:1527-1538`)."},{"query_id":"ci-1358","answer":"After defining the flags, call `cmd.MarkFlagsMutuallyExclusive(\"flag1\", \"flag2\", ...)`. Cobra annotates every named flag as belonging to that group and errors if more than one is supplied; it panics during setup if a named flag does not exist (`flag_groups.go:62-78`)."},{"query_id":"ci-1408","answer":"Define the global option as a persistent flag on the parent/root, then access it from the subcommand with `cmd.Flag(\"long-name\")`. `Flag` searches the command first and then inherited persistent flags (`command.go:1794-1803`); `persistentFlag` builds and searches the parent persistent-flag set when needed (`command.go:1805-1816`)."},{"query_id":"ci-1970","answer":"Use `cmd.Flags()` for the command's applicable flag set (`command.go:1643`). For categories, use `cmd.LocalFlags()` for locally defined flags and `cmd.InheritedFlags()` for flags inherited from parents; `InheritedFlags` returns a `FlagSet` assembled from parent persistent flags while excluding local overrides (`command.go:1669-1670,1695-1718`). Iterate a returned set with `VisitAll`, as demonstrated in `command.go:1713-1717`."},{"query_id":"ci-1991","answer":"INSUFFICIENT The response shows that `cmd.Flag(name)` locates a parent persistent flag through `persistentFlag` and `parentsPflags` (`command.go:1794-1816,1855-1874`), but it does not show an API for extracting that flag's typed value."},{"query_id":"ci-2249","answer":"Use `cmd.HasInheritedFlags()` to assert whether inherited flags exist, and inspect `cmd.InheritedFlags()` to test individual entries or enumerate them (`command.go:1695-1719,1766-1770`). To assert only usable inherited flags, use `cmd.HasAvailableInheritedFlags()`, which excludes hidden or deprecated flags (`command.go:1788-1792`)."},{"query_id":"ci-2314","answer":"Cobra's default handling does not distinguish them: `InitDefaultHelpFlag` creates one Boolean `help` flag with `h` as its shorthand (`command.go:1183-1201`). It will not create that default if a `help` flag already exists, but the response does not establish a supported mechanism for giving `-h` and `--help` separate behavior."},{"query_id":"ci-467","answer":"Yes—enable `rootCmd.TraverseChildren`. With traversal enabled Cobra uses `Root().Traverse(...)` (`completions.go:277-281`), and `Traverse` is specifically documented to find the command while parsing arguments/flags for each parent before recursing into the subcommand (`command.go:788-793,822-829`)."},{"query_id":"ci-511","answer":"Register a callback with `cobra.OnInitialize(func() { ... })` instead of trying to read execution-time values directly in Go's package `init`. `OnInitialize` stores functions to run when a command's `Execute` is called (`cobra.go:97-101`), and `(*Command).preRun` executes those callbacks during command processing (`command.go:1015-1019,926-937`). Persistent flags are available from `PersistentFlags()` (`command.go:1725-1735`)."},{"query_id":"ci-678","answer":"Use `cmd.SetArgs([]string{\"--flag\", \"value\"})` before executing the command in the test. `SetArgs` overrides the default `os.Args[1:]` specifically for cases such as testing (`command.go:274-279`)."},{"query_id":"ci-771","answer":"Implement completion in Go with `ValidArgsFunction` for arguments and `RegisterFlagCompletionFunc` for flags; these callbacks are portable across Bash, Zsh, Fish, and PowerShell (`site/content/completions/_index.md:477-479`). Shell-specific Bash-script callbacks such as `MarkFlagCustom` are ignored by Zsh. Cobra's supported generated completion targets are Bash, Zsh, Fish, and PowerShell (`site/content/user_guide.md:742`)."},{"query_id":"ci-943","answer":"The likely cause is that `Command.Version` is empty: `InitDefaultVersionFlag` immediately returns in that case. Set the command's `Version` field to a nonempty value. Cobra then creates `--version` automatically unless a flag with that name already exists; it adds `-v` only if that shorthand is available (`command.go:1200-1225`)."}]}
